description: This PHP class 'FormatWithDateTime' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format DateTime objects into a standard string representation ('Y-m-d H:i:s'). It is part of the 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\AccessStrategy\FormatValue' namespace, indicating it is used within the OrangeHRM system to handle formatting of date/time values in the maintenance access strategy context.

classes.name: FormatWithDateTime
classes.description: A class that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format DateTime objects into a standardized string format.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats a given value if it is an instance of DateTime into the 'Y-m-d H:i:s' string format.
